text: Men darna Manndikirɗe nunɗuɗe ɗen fii yimɓe Darngal ngal fii yo ɗe manndikire golle maɓɓe ɗen, tooñirtaake e nder nden Ñalaande hay wonkii uytaneede moƴƴi makko ɗin maaɗum ɓeydaneede bonɗe makki, hay si laatike ko peesirgal ngal no famɗiri wa yeru ko abbere khardal manndike ɗum Men adday ɗum, Men yonii hasbooɓe Meɗen hasba golle jeyaaɓe Amen ɓen.
